profile.headline: Software Engineer at Thumbtack
profile.summary: Mobile and Backend developer with close to 5 years of professional software development experience having strong problem solving, technical and analytical skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Contributed to Identity, Analytics, and Feedback Android SDKs which are integral to all yahoo, AOL, and HuffPost apps.

* Designed and implemented sign-in with QR code feature which allows users for a secure password-less sign-in experience and is now used by 70% of Yahoo userbase.

* Rearchitected authentication mechanism which simplified sign-in and sign-up flows for Yahoo Mobile users.

* Designed and developed Partner Client Authorization Flow for third-party clients in Yahoo Mobile Apps which provides a seamless experience to the user.

* Created Splunk and Looker dashboards with automated monitoring/alerting functionality allowing us to detect production issues early on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Implemented survey mechanism in Android SDK which is used by app Yahoo Apps for calculating Net Promoter Score.

* Improved SDK cold-start performance by 40%.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
* Development of the android and iOS applications with Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality.

* Working with the SLAM, GPS, Marker based, Object Recognition and Marker less technologies in the field of Augmented Reality.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Technologies: Android, Java

* Developed UI for Stock market android application.

* Added Reference videos for how to use android application and how to do analysis for stocks.

* Automatically analyze the stock data from datastore and intelligently provide statistics to the customer.

* Worked on Candle Stick Charts that displays lowest and highest price of the stock per minute.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: * Development of application using ASP.NET and android.

honors.title: Scholarship
honors.description: Awarded with scholarship for securing fifth rank at university level.

projects.title: Identity Web Service
projects.description:
- Improved flows and user behavior for yahoo/non-yahoo users when they want to register/sign-in for Yahoo Mobile.
- Updated Authorize API for showing consent and issuing authorization code for third-party clients in Yahoo Mobile Apps.
- Developed a new API for providing sign-out option in account switcher for inactive accounts with end-to-end test flow.

projects.title: Sign-in with QR
projects.description:
- Designed and developed QR code feature for Sign-in flow which is used by 70% of Yahoo users.
- Created QR Splunk dashboard and email alerts to measure daily sign-in users and discover production issues automatically.
- Drove and implemented features for both backend and client(SDK) side changes to improve user experience for QR code scanning from the mobile apps via in-app notification alert.
- Implemented UI for QR Scanner and in-app notification in Identity SDK.
- Created an end-to-end test plan and implemented it in BE and SDK via functional tests.
